about.en: Everyday maths for adults (P26, C4.3): numbers in Persian and Latin digits side by side, money, and the clock. A first three lessons as drafts; the content team adds the rest (about 20). Money is drawn as plain line drawings with a number, never a copy of a real banknote. Every Dari and Pashto line needs a native speaker's check, an adult educator's signature and a recorded clip for every step before release.
